comments.author: jue-jue-zi
comments.body: @tohtana Thanks for your contributions. After upgrading to v0.18.7, it seems that zero0 is slower than zero1 / zero2 for single machine training?

comments.author: tohtana
comments.body: @jue-jue-zi In theory, ZeRO-1 has more overhead than ZeRO-0, but in my experience, DeepSpeed hasn't focused much on the ZeRO-0 path. There might still be some underlying inefficiencies there.
